2026–2027 Supplemental Essay Prompts

In addition to the Common App personal essay, first-year applicants answer the questions below in the Example University section of the application.

Please respond to both of the following prompts. Each response should be no more than 250 words.

  1. Why are you interested in attending Example University? Tell us about the parts of our community you hope to join.
  2. Describe a time you changed your mind about something important to you. What did you learn from it?

Optional: If you wish, you may tell us about a hardship or circumstance that has affected your education in 150 words or fewer.
